_about: Hand-curated additions to the overseas build, each with the source it was read from. 'stints' are career-journey stops without stats (season, club, league, country), used where RealGM's International table was cut off or a player has no RealGM career page (src 'Wikipedia', or 'Club' for the clubs' own announcements, listed in 'sources'); seasons of leagues played inside one calendar year (NZNBL, BSN, BAL, NBL1...) are that year. 'noBBR' records that no Basketball-Reference page could be found for a player whose leagues it covers, so those seasons stay journey-only. 'checked' (with a 'note') marks a player searched for on 23 Oct 2026 with no RealGM, Basketball-Reference or Wikipedia page to read.
